clue.text: Personal appeal from cleaner's mum

parts.note: a char, or charwoman, is a British word for a cleaning lady
the apostrophe-s is read as the contraction of is
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Someone's charm seems to have been inherited from the cleaning lady's mother.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of cleaner's is not a possessive but 'is'. A char is a British cleaning woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: magnetic personal charm that draws people to someone.

clue.text: He single-handedly fought to secure eternal youth

definitions.text: He single-handedly fought to secure eternal youth

parts.words: He single-handedly fought to secure eternal youth
parts.note: the Peter Pan villain had one hand, a hook replacing the other, and fought the boy who never grew up

explanation.surface: A lone hero battled to win the secret of staying young forever.
explanation.walkthrough: Single-handedly is literal: the pirate lost a hand to the crocodile. To secure is to capture Peter Pan, the eternal youth.
explanation.definitionFit: The one-handed pirate of J.M. Barrie's play fights Peter Pan, the boy who never grows up.

clue.text: Excitement about love

parts.note: ado is fuss or excitement
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Getting excited over love.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to adore someone is to love them deeply.

clue.text: Black singer caught out flirt, becoming uncomfortable

indicators.note: the caught letter is left out of the singer's name

parts.note: Cilla Black was a British singer and TV presenter
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a tease is a flirt

explanation.surface: A black singer caught out as a flirt feels awkward.
explanation.walkthrough: Black is a surname: Cilla Black was a 1960s Liverpool pop singer. 'out' drops C from CILLA.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to be ill at ease is to feel uneasy or uncomfortable.

clue.text: Space station with a satellite

parts.note: Mir was the Soviet and Russian space station
and means together with

explanation.surface: A space station comes with a satellite.
explanation.walkthrough: The satellite is not a man-made one but a natural moon.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Miranda is one of the moons of Uranus.

clue.text: Husband leaves old cigarette holder in the wrong place

indicators.note: the husband departs from the word, so his letter is taken out

parts.note: an ashtray holds cigarettes; old because smoking indoors has become rare

explanation.surface: A husband walks out, and the old ashtray has been put somewhere it shouldn't be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' drops H from ASHTRAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something gone off its proper path or out of its place has gone astray.

clue.text: Hamper and overcome Brexit, ultimately

parts.note: to stun is to overwhelm or overcome

indicators.note: points at the closing letter of Brexit

explanation.surface: Brexit, in the end, held the country back and overwhelmed it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to stunt growth is to hinder or hamper it.

clue.text: Terraced property originally refurbished to provide welcome for honoured guests

indicators.note: a refurbished house is made over, so these letters are reworked
points at the opening letter of property

explanation.surface: A terraced house was done up to give VIP visitors a proper reception.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refurbished' rearranges TERRACED plus P. A terraced house is one in a row of joined houses, common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: rolling out the red carpet means giving important visitors a special welcome.

clue.text: In Moscow, no nationalist has been expelled so far

indicators.note: the nationalist is thrown out, so that letter is removed

parts.note: nyet is Russian for no

explanation.surface: In Moscow, no nationalist has yet been thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads In Moscow, no ... as a statement; the wordplay wants the Russian word for no.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: yet means up to now, so far.

clue.text: Maybe Austin has both feet separately inserted in sneakers

indicators.note: the second foot letter is likewise placed inside the name
the two foot letters go in one at a time, at different places in the name

parts.note: Austin Powers is the spy hero of the Mike Myers comedy films, so Austin is an example of a Powers
the right foot of the pair, R being the abbreviation for right
the left foot of the pair, L being the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A spy in sneakers puts both feet into his shoes one at a time.
explanation.walkthrough: R goes in after the P of POWERS and L after the W. 'Maybe' marks Austin as one example of someone named Powers.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword sense: sneakers here are people who creep about stealthily, as prowlers do.

clue.text: One said to Macron: "Pence is leading expert"

indicators.note: the pence letter goes in front of the rest

parts.note: in French, as the French president would put it, one is un and said is dit

explanation.surface: A quote addressed to the French president pairs him with Mike Pence as a political expert.
explanation.walkthrough: Pence is the US politician in the surface but the British coin abbreviation P in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a pundit is an authority who offers opinions on a subject, especially in the media.

clue.text: Wise man has head lowered for a long time

indicators.note: in a down clue the top letter is brought down to the bottom

parts.note: a sage is a wise man

explanation.surface: A wise man bows his head for a long time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has head lowered' moves the first letter S to the end, which in a down answer is the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: waiting ages means waiting a very long time.

clue.text: Prevent beaver trashing boxes

indicators.note: the two words contain the answer within them, enclosing it like a box

explanation.surface: Someone tries to stop a beaver wrecking some boxes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxes' is a verb: the phrase beaver trashing contains the letters across its words.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to avert a disaster is to ward it off or prevent it.

clue.text: Unusual thing occurring prior to Maine's autumn sunset

indicators.note: the anagram comes before the next piece
an unusual arrangement of the letters of thing gives a new word

parts.note: Maine is a US state, and Americans call autumn the fall

explanation.surface: Something strange happens before autumn in Maine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusual' rearranges THING into NIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: nightfall is the onset of dark at the end of the day, around sunset.

clue.text: It, with electrode, is dodgy way to find the truth

indicators.note: something dodgy is unreliable, so the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: A polygraph with an electrode attached is an unreliable way to discover the truth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is dodgy' rearranges IT and ELECTRODE; the surface fits, since polygraph results are disputed.
explanation.definitionFit: A polygraph measures bodily responses to try to tell whether someone is truthful.

clue.text: Peaceful state of new senator finally accepted by Trump?

indicators.note: the senator's final letter is taken in by the name

parts.note: Ivana Trump was Donald Trump's first wife

indicators.note: points at the closing letter of senator

explanation.surface: A newly elected senator, finally welcomed by President Trump, is at peace.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that Trump is a different Trump from the obvious one: Ivana, who takes in R after her I.
explanation.definitionFit: In Buddhism, nirvana is the blissful state of release from desire and suffering; loosely any state of perfect peace.

clue.text: Again prepare for boring holiday period

indicators.note: boring as drilling into: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a recess is a break, such as a parliament's holiday
pro means for, in favour of

explanation.surface: Getting ready again for a dull holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boring' looks like dull, but it means drilling into: PRO bores into RECESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to reprocess material is to treat or prepare it once more.

clue.text: Paddy, Henry and Earl produce choral movement

parts.note: a paddy is a fit of temper, as is a strop
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Three men, Paddy, Henry and Earl, put on a piece of choral music.
explanation.walkthrough: Paddy is not an Irishman but a fit of temper; STROP is British slang for a sulk or tantrum.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek drama a strophe is the section of an ode sung by the chorus as it moves one way.

clue.text: Unsophisticated to peel sprout twice? It's disgusting when cooked

indicators.note: peeling strips off the outer layer, here the end letters
the peeling is done two times over

parts.note: ugh is an exclamation of disgust

indicators.note: cooked as in tampered with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Peeling a sprout twice is crude, and it's revolting once cooked.
explanation.walkthrough: Peeling SPROUT once leaves PROU, twice leaves RO. 'cooked' rearranges WHEN into HEWN.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: rough-hewn means crudely shaped, hence unrefined or unsophisticated.

clue.text: Subjugate work by the media

indicators.note: places one piece beside the other

parts.note: OP, short for opus, is a musical work
the press is the news media collectively

explanation.surface: Something about a work's subjugation by the press.
explanation.walkthrough: OP is the abbreviation for opus, a numbered composition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to oppress a people is to keep them down harshly, to subjugate them.

clue.text: Raw mineral found beneath Sweden …

indicators.note: in a down answer the second piece sits under the first

parts.note: S is the international vehicle code for Sweden
ore is mineral-bearing rock

explanation.surface: Raw mineral is discovered under Sweden.
explanation.walkthrough: Raw looks like it describes the mineral; it is the definition, as in sore skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a raw wound is a painful, tender one.

clue.text: Hurry to go back and forth changing taps

indicators.note: taps are marked hot and cold, H and C, so one tap letter is swapped for the other

parts.note: to shuttle is to travel back and forth repeatedly

explanation.surface: A plumber rushes about, going to and fro swapping taps.
explanation.walkthrough: Taps are labelled H (hot) and C (cold); swapping the H of SHUTTLE for C gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to scuttle is to run with short quick steps, to hurry along.

clue.text: … described by Glossop history teacher

indicators.note: to describe a shape is to draw round it, so the words enclose the letters

explanation.surface: A history teacher from Glossop, a Derbyshire town, is described.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to 20 down but plays no part. Glossop is a town in Derbyshire.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Greece the Sophists were paid teachers of rhetoric and philosophy.

clue.text: Rousing person from Irish town, flawless on reflection

parts.note: Knock is a town in County Mayo famous for its shrine

indicators.note: a reflection reverses an image, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: pure means flawless

explanation.surface: Someone from an Irish town thinks back and finds a perfect stirring figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on reflection' turns PURE into ERUP. A knocker-up was a person in industrial Britain paid to tap on windows to wake workers.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical job: the knocker-up went round before dawn rousing people for work.

clue.text: Acclaim resulting from solving most of sudoku

indicators.note: solving a puzzle works it out, so the letters are worked into a new order
all but the closing letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: Praise comes from completing most of a sudoku.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' drops the final U, and 'solving' rearranges SUDOK.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: kudos is praise and honour earned by an achievement.

clue.text: Is in possession of bit of temazepam, ecstasy and speed

parts.note: has means owns or possesses

indicators.note: a small bit is the first letter of temazepam

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone is caught carrying temazepam, ecstasy and speed.
explanation.walkthrough: Speed looks like another drug in the list, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: haste is swiftness of action, speed.

clue.text: Mock son's company very loudly

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
FF is fortissimo, the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at their son's firm, very loudly.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to scoff at something is to ridicule or mock it.

clue.text: Changes the last word, originally deemed substandard

parts.note: amen is the word that closes a prayer

indicators.note: each of the next two words gives its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone revises the final word after it was judged not good enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' takes D and S from deemed substandard.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: amends as a verb means alters or changes a text.

clue.text: Military commander once more not popular

indicators.note: the popular word is not included, so it is taken out

parts.note: again means once more
in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: The military commander is unpopular once more.
explanation.walkthrough: An aga was a commander or official in the Ottoman Empire.
explanation.definitionFit: An aga was a high-ranking Ottoman military officer or chief.

clue.text: It provides relief, if able to, at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A boat that brings relief to those at sea when it can.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' fits the surface perfectly but signals an anagram of IF ABLE TO.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifeboat brings rescue and relief to sailors in trouble.

clue.text: Help band member start off

indicators.note: the beginning letter is taken off the word

parts.note: a bassist plays bass guitar in a band

explanation.surface: A band member offers help getting things started.
explanation.walkthrough: 'start off' removes the first letter B from BASSIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to assist is to help.

clue.text: Tolerate mean advocate

definitions.meaning: put up with, as in I won't ... it
represent or signify, as initials do

explanation.surface: Put up with a nasty lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: A triple definition: each word alone is a sense of the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom with three senses: put up with, signify, and champion a cause.
